scripts.dev: npm run build && node ../shared/run-with-env.mjs node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev --test-scheduled --env-file ../.env
scripts.db:migrate:local: node ../shared/run-with-env.mjs node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node ../shared/run-with-env.mjs node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:worker
scripts.deploy:with-migrations: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy:worker
